# Pinoy Ball

> Free 2026-2027 NBA predictions today, tonight and tomorrow. Expert NBA betting predictions, team vs team picks, matchup previews and live PHT schedules. All game dates and tip-off times are reported in Philippine Standard Time (PHT / UTC+8).

## Core Sections
- [Upcoming NBA Predictions](https://www.pinoyball.com/): Active team-vs-team NBA winner picks, confidence tiers, and matchup previews in PHT.
- [Prediction Results Archive](https://www.pinoyball.com/archive/): Transparent record of completed NBA predictions, verified winners, final scores, and overall win rate (0% — 0W-0L).
- [NBA Schedule (PHT)](https://www.pinoyball.com/schedule/): NBA regular-season schedule converted to Philippine Standard Time.
- [Prediction Methodology](https://www.pinoyball.com/methodology/): Six-pillar editorial framework, confidence tiers, injury rules, and grading accountability.
- [Full LLM Corpus](https://www.pinoyball.com/llms-full.txt): Complete structured text of all current and archived matchup predictions.
